description: In QBlade, generate a NACA 4-digit airfoil profile using the built-in NACA Airfoil Generator. Navigate to the Airfoil Design module and use the NACA generator to create a NACA 4412 airfoil with 100 panel discretization points. After generating, export the airfoil coordinates to /home/ga/Documents/airfoils/generated_naca4412.dat.
